)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
dogs_zurich = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Data preparation: Count the number of dogs by breed
breed_counts = dogs_zurich['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a bar plot for the top 10 breeds
sns.barplot(
    x=breed_counts.values,
    y=breed_counts.index,
    palette='viridis'
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Breed', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
